definition: Surface properties of transition metal oxides concern how the composition, structure and electronic state at their surfaces affect interactions such as adsorption and reactivity.
entry_text: Surface properties of transition metal oxides concern how the composition, structure and electronic state at their surfaces affect interactions such as adsorption and reactivity.
example: A materials scientist compares how oxygen vacancies influence adsorption on two oxide surfaces.
label: Surface properties of transition metal oxides
